summary.zh: 可用於半導體與化學產業高純度液體的供應、輸送與儲存，內表面平滑並可依需求製作圓筒或方形槽體。
summary.en: For supplying, transporting, and storing high-purity liquids in semiconductor and chemical applications, with smooth inner surfaces and cylindrical or square configurations.

zh: TEFPASS PFA HP Vessel：PFA-HP、PFA-HP PLUS 材質
可應用於高純度化學液供應與輸送
Vessel 容器設計可自然排液，支援高潔淨儲存需求
en: TEFPASS PFA HP Vessel: PFA-HP and PFA-HP PLUS materials
Designed for high-purity chemical supply and transportation
Vessel container design supports natural drainage and ultra-high-purity storage

specs.zh: PFA HP Vessel：厚度 7 mm，容量 20-40 L，設計壓力 3.5 kg/cm²，設計溫度 110°C。TEFPASS Vessel：4” 容量 1.8-7.4 L、6” 容量 4.7-19 L、8” 容量 8.6-35.4 L，設計壓力 0-4 kg/cm²，設計溫度 -20-80°C。
specs.en: PFA HP Vessel: 7 mm thickness, 20-40 L capacity, 3.5 kg/cm² design pressure, 110°C design temperature. TEFPASS Vessel: 4 in. 1.8-7.4 L, 6 in. 4.7-19 L, 8 in. 8.6-35.4 L, 0-4 kg/cm² design pressure, -20-80°C design temperature.

application.zh: 半導體與化學產業高純度液體供應、輸送、儲存及濕製程設備應用。
application.en: High-purity liquid supply, transportation, storage, and wet-process equipment applications for semiconductor and chemical industries.

summary.zh: 包含 8 吋熱交換器、10x8 Tube 熱熔、多孔板與 127 支熱交換器展示。
summary.en: Includes 8-inch heat exchanger, 10x8 tube fusion, tube sheet, and 127-tube heat exchanger exhibits.

zh: 多孔板與管束結構展示
展示焊接與熱熔加工能力
en: Tube sheet and tube bundle structure display

specs.zh: 展示項目含 8” 熱交換器、10x8 Tube、127 支熱交換器。
specs.en: Exhibits include 8-inch heat exchanger, 10x8 tube, and 127-tube unit.

application.zh: 濕製程溫控、化學液熱交換與高潔淨流體處理。
application.en: Wet-process temperature control, chemical heat exchange, and high-purity fluid handling.

summary.zh: 以可組裝樣品展示擴口、對焊、閥件與 Tube 應用，方便現場互動說明。
summary.en: Interactive samples for flared, butt-welded, valve, and tube applications for easier on-site demonstrations.

zh: 展示櫃搭配光源與 iPad 解說
en: Display cabinet with lighting and iPad guidance

specs.zh: 包含擴口、對焊、閥件與 Tube 樣品。
specs.en: Includes flared, butt-welded, valve, and tube samples.

application.zh: 化學液管路、設備配管、客製化連接件。
application.en: Chemical piping, tool plumbing, and custom connection components.

summary.zh: 展示 PFA 取樣瓶，支援高潔淨樣品收集與保存需求。
summary.en: PFA sampling bottles for high-purity sample collection and storage.

zh: PFA 取樣瓶兩組共 10 款
支援樣品收集與保存需求
en: Two PFA sampling-bottle sets with 10 styles
Supports sample collection and storage needs

specs.zh: PFA 取樣瓶規格依正式型錄更新。
specs.en: PFA sampling bottle specifications to be finalized with the official catalog.

application.zh: 化學液取樣、實驗室保存、製程品質檢測。
application.en: Chemical sampling, lab storage, and process quality inspection.

summary.zh: 展示內襯工藝、焊接、PFA Sheet、PTFE Etched Sheet 與 M-PTFE CBK 材料應用。
summary.en: Lining process, welding, PFA Sheet, PTFE Etched Sheet, and M-PTFE CBK material applications.

zh: 本體展示尺寸約 W395 x H329 x D300 mm
支援耐化與結構保護需求
en: Display body approx. W395 x H329 x D300 mm
Supports chemical resistance and structural protection

specs.zh: 材料含 PFA Sheet、PTFE Etched Sheet、M-PTFE CBK。
specs.en: Materials include PFA Sheet, PTFE Etched Sheet, and M-PTFE CBK.

application.zh: 槽體內襯、耐化板材、設備保護層。
application.en: Tank lining, chemical-resistant panels, and equipment protective layers.

summary.zh: 展示板模組、管模組、微孔膜、微孔管與 ETFE Film 離型膜等研發材料。
summary.en: R&D materials including plate module, tube module, microporous film, microporous tube, and ETFE release film.

zh: ETFE Film 含鏡面與霧面
en: ETFE Film includes glossy and matte surfaces

specs.zh: 板模組 W180 x H375 x D225 mm；管模組 W480 x H110 x D130 mm。
specs.en: Plate module W180 x H375 x D225 mm; tube module W480 x H110 x D130 mm.

application.zh: 研發材料展示、薄膜應用、微孔結構與客製模組討論。
application.en: R&D material showcase, film applications, microporous structures, and custom module discussions.
